result.summary: The page is generally polished, but several elements appear clipped or obscured, creating a broken-looking experience.

issues.description: The horizontal category row is cut off on the right edge, showing only part of the next category pill without an obvious indication that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scrolling affordance or spacing, and ensure the clipped pill is intentionally presented as a carousel item.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the “Fastest near you” row is significantly clipped at the right edge, including its image and restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Use a properly contained horizontal carousel with consistent card widths, or allow the row to scroll while preserving a clear partial-card affordance.

issues.description: A large loading spinner is visible over the Tokomaru Ramen Bar image, making the restaurant card look stuck in a loading state.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner once the image/content has loaded, or show a smaller skeleton/loading state until the card is ready.

issues.description: The second popular restaurant card is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, with its content cut off at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the navigation bar height so users can scroll the card fully above the fixed navigation.
